answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Every claim climbs the tide of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the meadow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The prism of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
